IFWiki: Necrotic Drift

Necrotic Drift, version 1.03, by Robb Sherwin. This is a graphical text adventure game, and as such requires a minimum resolution of 800x600. It does not support text-only mode. The archive contains a machine independent Hugo game file, plus graphics and music.
